taskDescription: Complete the crossword using key terms from MI1.{1-2,10,12-13} | General Microbiology I: History, Morphology, Sterilisation & Staining.

words.clue: French scientist who proved that specific diseases are caused by specific microorganisms through germ theory
German bacteriologist who established four scientific postulates to prove microbial causality of disease
Antibiotic discovered in 1928 from Penicillium mould that killed Staphylococcus colonies
British surgeon who revolutionized surgery by introducing antiseptic technique using carbolic acid
Lung disease caused by Mycobacterium tuberculosis, the organism identified by Koch in 1882
Solid culture medium suggested by Angelina Fanny Hesse that enabled bacterial isolation and cultivation
Preventive biological preparation developed by Pasteur against cholera, anthrax, and rabies
Any microorganism that is always inherently capable of causing disease in the human host
Polysaccharide outer layer of bacteria that protects them from being engulfed by phagocytic cells
Dense community of microorganisms that protects itself from antibiotics and immune system clearance
The degree or severity of disease caused by a pathogenic microorganism
Microorganism that is neutral toward the host or provides benefit without causing harm
